scope: isolated H02 SQLite adapter and H03/H04/H06 research evidence

actions.sql_transaction: initialize_database: BEGIN, singleton absence check, complete seed inserts, COMMIT
isolation_assumptions: single SQLite connection
schema creation precedes seed transaction
foreign-key enforcement is enabled by the H02 connection factory
actions.recovery_behavior: any validation or SQLite error rolls back the seed transaction; post-commit read_state must equal the seed state

actions.abstract_action: reconstruct the complete authoritative history or reject
actions.sql_transaction: read-only SELECT reconstruction through read_state; no write transaction
isolation_assumptions: one stable connection view during reconstruction
a caller must not treat a selected root as sufficient
uniqueness_constraints: all table primary keys and foreign keys are rechecked by typed row reconstruction
cached ANF-set and publication roots must rederive
actions.recovery_behavior: missing, surplus, crossed, stale, malformed, or noncanonical rows raise H02StorageError; no state-changing operation may proceed

actions.abstract_action: atomically publish successor state, authority, atom, evidence, nullifier, outbox, and ANF relation
actions.sql_transaction: publish_atom: BEGIN IMMEDIATE; read PRE; root/authority CAS; update snapshot_meta; insert logical rows; read complete POST; COMMIT
isolation_assumptions: BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes SQLite writers for this connection/database
CAS predicates use expected state, snapshot, publication, and authority heads
uncommitted rows are not the durable authority boundary
uniqueness_constraints: foreign keys from evidence/nullifier/outbox/ANF to atom
actions.recovery_behavior: typed stale-CAS rejects roll back; any insert/read mismatch rolls back; successful COMMIT returns one H02CommitV1; post-COMMIT response loss is modeled by H03/H04
nonclaims: D08 fixture has an empty outbox

actions.abstract_action: append the next authority epoch as part of the publication atom
actions.sql_transaction: publish_atom optional next_authority branch calls _insert_authority inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
isolation_assumptions: authority epoch append must be one exact successor
allowed writer rows share the transaction
actions.recovery_behavior: H03 authority-helper fault points roll back on the harness connection; full D08 publication with a verifier-produced authority-transition atom remains open
nonclaims: current D08 fixture does not construct an authority-transition atom

actions.abstract_action: publish a destination acknowledgment bound to a committed effect
actions.sql_transaction: no H02 acknowledgment-write operation; delivery_acks table is declared and reopened but not populated by a worker
isolation_assumptions: an acknowledgment must be after committed outbox membership
destination receipt provenance must be verified at use
uniqueness_constraints: delivery_acks.effect_id primary key in the logical schema
missing foreign-key/worker binding remains an open adapter obligation
actions.recovery_behavior: no H02 recovery behavior is claimed; I05-I07 must define provenance, lost-ack, and redelivery behavior

actions.abstract_action: classify a retry against canonical durable commit identity and current state
actions.sql_transaction: no public retry classifier is mounted in H02; only the lower-level CAS and canonical reopen are available
isolation_assumptions: client indeterminacy is distinct from durable outcome
commit identity, fingerprint, nonce, and expected roots must be compared
uniqueness_constraints: atom commit_id and nullifier uniqueness are available to a future classifier
no retry API/refinement is declared here
actions.recovery_behavior: H04 only classifies storage after a fault; H05 and later retry work must distinguish already committed, absent retryable, stale, and definite collision

actions.abstract_action: after a crash expose exact PRE, exact POST, or rejection
actions.sql_transaction: H03 fault hook interrupts a named boundary; H04 child process exits; parent opens a fresh connection and calls read_state
isolation_assumptions: SQLite connection close rolls back an uncommitted transaction in this harness
the post-COMMIT point is already durable before the child exits
uniqueness_constraints: complete state equality includes all rederived row families and roots
a third layout is classified REJECTED
actions.recovery_behavior: 15 ordinary pre-COMMIT points recover exact PRE; post-COMMIT/pre-response recovers exact POST; authority-helper-only points remain deferred
nonclaims: no power-loss or filesystem crash proof

actions.abstract_action: ensure the storage configuration satisfies the assumed transaction profile
actions.sql_transaction: H06 observes pragmas outside an open transaction; configure helper applies WAL/FULL/foreign_keys/busy_timeout/NORMAL and rechecks
isolation_assumptions: file-backed SQLite database
WAL and synchronous FULL are required observed settings
configuration must be checked before publication
uniqueness_constraints: not a row uniqueness property; typed profile checker rejects missing or weakened settings
actions.recovery_behavior: weak profile returns a stable typed rejection; H06 is not automatically wired into H02 production startup

actions.abstract_action: deliver each committed outbox effect with stable identity and destination idempotency
actions.sql_transaction: H02 inserts outbox rows inside publication but has no worker lease/send/ack transaction
isolation_assumptions: effect identity is derived from commit, ordinal, destination, payload root, and writer profile
destination acknowledgment must retain provenance
uniqueness_constraints: publication_outbox effect_id primary key and (commit_id, ordinal) uniqueness
actions.recovery_behavior: H04 verifies storage relation only; I01-I07 must define leasing, redelivery, lost acknowledgment, and destination receipt behavior

global_nonclaims: no production datastore, caller, migration, value movement, or zUSD safety theorem is established
